narrative.intro: TriWest Healthcare Alliance has $900M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. TriWest Healthcare Alliance received 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $300M. TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligations are down 94.6% year over year, reflecting a much smaller fiscal-year-to-date total compared with prior full fiscal years. TriWest Healthcare Alliance recorded larger obligations in earlier years, including $7.4B in FY22, $8B in FY23, $8.4B in FY24, $13.4B in FY25, and $16.6B in FY26. TriWest Healthcare Alliance activity in FY2027 to date is concentrated in one NAICS market: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers, which accounts for $900M. TriWest Healthcare Alliance shows no obligations so far in Pharmacy Benefit Management and Other Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds, where the value is $0. This snapshot is fiscal year to date and can change as the year progresses.
